QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: useGoogle3DMapSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Use the online Google 3D Maps source instead of local 3D sources.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: google3DMapsApiKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Google Maps JavaScript API key used by the online Google 3D Maps source.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: useExternal3DMapSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Use an externally generated 3D model map instead of the local OSM 3D map file.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: external3DMapFilePath
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Path to an external 3D model map file. OBJ, glTF, GLB and Balsam QML load directly; FBX, DAE, STL and PLY are imported through Qt Balsam conversion.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.default: Please select an external 3D model file

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: external3DMapOriginLatitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Latitude of the external 3D map local origin in WGS84.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: external3DMapOriginLongitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Longitude of the external 3D map local origin in WGS84.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: external3DMapOriginAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Altitude of the external 3D map local origin.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: external3DMapUnitToMeters
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Meters represented by one model unit. Use 0.01 for Unreal centimeter exports and 1.0 for meter-based glTF/OBJ exports.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: external3DMapScale
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Extra scale multiplier for the external 3D map after unit conversion.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: external3DMapYaw
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Yaw angle that rotates the external 3D map into QGC ENU coordinates. Zero means model +Y points north and +X points east.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: osmFilePath
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Path to the OSM file for the 3D viewer.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: buildingLevelHeight
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Average Height for each level of the buildings

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: altitudeBias
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Altitude bias for vehicles in the 3D View
